correctness.rationale: For every linear ternary word length n>=1, the proof classifies each nine-entry nonnegative ordered-adjacent-pair matrix by the necessary-and-sufficient weak-connectivity and zero/unit-divergence criterion for Euler trails; cases with 0, 2 or 3 offdiagonal active vertices are disjoint and exhaustive, with all loops and orientations counted. Integer flow parametrizations yield explicit closed/open generating functions, and exact rational simplification produces the stated formula. Independent finite word enumeration through n=11 and exhaustive matrix-feasibility enumeration through n=15 corroborate exact coefficients without being used as infinite proof. The limiting constant follows from the unique leading order-seven pole at 1.

value.rationale: Counts the full range of distinguishable outputs of the natural length-two ordered-frequency reconstruction channel over the smallest nonbinary alphabet, and hence its exact maximum noiseless reconstruction-code cardinality, for every word length. This is the finite-length refinement of a well-motivated earlier first-order Markov-type counting problem whose published exact open-endpoint term was unevaluated. The rational GF also exposes eventual degree-six quasipolynomial dependence with period dividing six. The all-length result is not a routine finite table and is materially stronger than known asymptotics; it is deliberately restricted to length-two ternary profiles.
